skill.summary: Scrape and analyze all active Google, Meta, and TikTok ads from competitors, then rebuild winning creatives, copy, and video ads tailored to your brand.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Google & Meta Ads Spy Tool – a comprehensive competitive intelligence tool for paid advertising.

- Instantly scrape and analyze all active Google, Meta, and TikTok ads from any competitor.
- Automatically identify proven, high-performing ads using spend duration as signal.
- Extract ad creative assets, landing page strategies, and detailed creative analysis.
- Rebuild winning ads for your brand using Claude AI, with multiple angle variations.
- Generate ready-to-use video ad versions via InVideo AI.
- Output a full swipe file and actionable campaign strategy for your next paid ads launch.
